request.query: If each element of a set is at most a finite maximum then the supremum is at most that maximum

items.name: Finset.sup'_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : SemilatticeSup α] {s : Finset β} (H : s.Nonempty) (f : β → α) {a : α},
  (∀ b ∈ s, f b ≤ a) → s.sup' H f ≤ a

items.name: sSup_le
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : CompleteSemilatticeSup α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, (∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a) → sSup s ≤ a

items.name: SupSet.sSup
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → [self : SupSet α] → Set α → α

items.name: Finite.le_ciSup
items.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Finite ι] [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (f : ι → α) (i : ι), f i ≤ ⨆ j, f j

items.name: Real.sSup_le
items.type: ∀ {s : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ a) → 0 ≤ a → sSup s ≤ a

items.name: sSup_le_iff
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : CompleteSemilatticeSup α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, sSup s ≤ a ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a

items.name: Finset.Nonempty.csSup_eq_max'
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] {s : Finset α} (h : s.Nonempty), sSup ↑s = s.max' h

items.name: Set.Finite.ciSup_lt_iff
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] {a : α} {s : Set ι} {f : ι → α},
  s.Finite → (∃ x ∈ s, sSup ∅ ≤ f x) → (⨆ i ∈ s, f i < a ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, f x < a)
